product.name: Sinotruck Pickup Passenger Version
product.description: SINOTRUCK pickup passenger version offers comfortable dual-purpose transportation for both passengers and cargo.

performanceItems.title: 2.0T turbocharged direct injection engine + 8AT gearbox
performanceItems.description: 2.0T turbocharged engine, good power and fuel economy, The engine is mated to an 8AT transmission, and the power response is smooth

performanceItems.title: Same platform as the Pickup
performanceItems.description: The same platform as the pickup, with a load-bearing body, front MacPherson independent suspension, and rear multi-link suspension, ensuring comfort and load capacity.

performanceItems.title: Powerful performance and wildness
performanceItems.description: Front MacPherson independent suspension, rear multi-link independent suspension. The body is strong and stable, ensuring a smooth driving experience.
